jobs.occupation: Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our global team as a highly skilled Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d), acting as a central hub of expertise and support for Power Transformer and Shunt Reactors engineers in our factories worldwide. Your role is crucial for ensuring our design processes are efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving. You will focus on providing support in applying solutions and guiding engineers, working closely with factories in Brazil, Mexico, and the USA to implement new tools, design rules, and innovative solutions. By connecting factory needs with our R&D development team, you will help shape the next generation of design technology and foster a culture of continuous learning.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide quick technical support to product engineers and assist transformer engineers with R&D rules and tools to minimize downtime
* Conduct pre-release tests of tools in real-world scenarios and provide feedback to developers
* Improve information flow and facilitate communication between factories, R&D, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with factory needs
* Ensure consistent global quality through structured technology transfer and work on a centralized knowledge hub for engineers
* Cultivate a community for experts to share knowledge and develop training programs for widespread adoption of best practices
* Propose improvements for tools and rules based on factory experiences, linking R&D advancements with practical engineering applications

What You Bring

* A completed degree in Electrical Engineering
* Longterm experience in Large Power Transformers and Shunt Reactors Design
* Strong understanding of various transformer and reactor types, including electrical design and calculations for dielectric, electro-magnetic, heating, cooling, and noise
* Good understanding of transformer components and their interactions, such as the core, windings, insulation, and leads
* A solid understanding of engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality processes, along with experience in technical product development
* Proficiency in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Junior Technology Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Technology Manager by gathering, structuring, and maintaining technology scouting intelligence across emerging technologies, startups, research developments, market signals, and innovation ecosystems relevant to Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve monitoring technology domains, conducting desk research, and preparing technology opportunity profiles. You will play a key role in ensuring that external signals are captured consistently and translated into clear inputs for further assessment, contributing to the PRM Technology Radar and other analytical activities.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitor selected technology domains, startups, research institutions, publications, and market developments relevant to Grid Technologies
* Capture early technology signals and maintain structured scouting inputs across H1–H4 horizons
* Maintain and update Technology Radar entries, ensuring consistent documentation of technology signals and assessment status
* Support preparation for interactions with startups, universities, and research institutes, including background notes and technology summaries
* Maintain scouting records and briefing materials in the central repository, preparing concise summaries and visual inputs for technology briefings
* Use digital and AI-enabled tools to improve searchability, synthesis, and reuse of technology intelligence

What You Bring

* Relevant bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering, technology management, business, innovation management, data analytics, or a related field
* First expereinces in technology scouting, research, strategy, innovation, R&D, consulting, or market intelligence
* Very good understanding of research and the technology of Siemens Energy, with a willingness to learn more
* Curiosity for emerging technologies, energy systems, grid technologies, startups, and innovation ecosystems
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure information and summarize complex topics clearly
* Fluent in English, with good communication skills and attention to detail

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.

This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.

The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.

**Job Responsibilities:** 

- Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market
- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP
- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients
- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects

Qualifications

- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)
- DC Experience in accountable DM position
- Proficient in contractual German and English
- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills are essential

Additional Information

Why join us?
You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.

If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Spectrum & Regulatory Affairs team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student within Frequency Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of Airbus?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Frequency Management team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Munich
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Supporting interference simulations between different RF systems in MATLAB
- Develop software modules such as propagation models, antenna radiation patterns for incorporation into the RF simulation. Including the development of relevant documentation.
- Support the development of technical reports for various international fora such as the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), a specialized agency of the United Nations.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled student in Electrical Engineering, General Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a similar field of study
- Basic knowledge of wireless communications, especially in calculating Link Budgets
- Advanced Programming skills, preferably with MATLAB
- English: Fluent
- German or French would be a plus
- You are a good team player, have excellent communication skills, and are able to work autonomously and proactively.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Our Team

Our Molex team is an active partner in the automotive industry. You will find an exciting and innovative workplace in an international environment. Our team is collaborative, and we have a respectful work atmosphere, where you will have the opportunity to bring in your own creative ideas.

What You Will Do

Molex Connectivity GmbH in Walldorf is a key European engineering and manufacturing site within the Molex organization, focused on precision interconnects, optical modules and customer‑specific assemblies. Our local teams combine product development, process engineering and production expertise to bring innovative and durable solutions from prototype to high‑volume manufacturing.

Your Job

Are you an inventive engineer driven by solving complex problems and bringing cutting-edge product designs to life? At Molex, we are looking for a passionate Product Development Engineer to join our High Voltage Connector team, where your expertise in fundamental engineering principles and critical thinking will directly influence the development of advanced, high-performance products.

In this role, you will leverage powerful design tools such as CAD, tolerance analysis, FEA, FMEA, and DVP&R to create innovative solutions and overcome technical challenges. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, take ownership of product designs, and contribute to delivering outstanding results within schedule - supported by mentorship from experienced leaders.

: Wolfsburg OR Munich preferred - Remote in Germany as an option for a great fit!

Our Team

You will be working with engineering, production, operations cross functionally at a global scope. Most of team members within your team are based across the globe. You will be directly reporting to the Engineering Manager High Power Europe/India.

At Molex, you will be part of a forward-thinking culture that values creativity, continuous learning, and pushing the boundaries of technology. If you are ready to accelerate your career and help shape the future of engineering excellence, apply today and join our dynamic team!

What You Will Do

- Support concept development, ensuring designs are manufacturable, cost-effective, and meet customer requirements.
- Conduct DFMEA, FEA, tolerance analysis, and other analytical studies with guidance from senior engineers.
- Create and maintain product models and drawings using GD&T, ensuring proper datum selection, dimensioning, and tolerancing, with support from experienced engineers.
- Assist in documenting project scope, requirements, feasibility, and engineering work plans.
- Develop test plans (DVP&R) and analyze test results using statistical methods; perform DOE, Hypothesis Testing, and Capability Studies.

- Select materials for plastic injection molded and metal stamped components.

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
- Extensive experience in product design and its workflows
- Solid understanding of CAD/3D Modelling, Plastic, and Injection Molding
- Experience using analytical studies (FEA, tolerance stacks, DFMEA, etc.) as part of a product development process
- Solid knowledge of validation plans and analysing test results to ensure a product meets performance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to use structured problem-solving methods to systematically determine root causes for complex technical issues
- Ability to travel approximately 20% (international)
- Fluent in English and German

What Will Put You Ahead

- Product design experience in the automotive industry, preferably in connector design
- Automotive High Voltage Connector development knowledge and experience
- Knowledge of resins, metals, engineering tools and processes, and manufacturing processes (injection molding, stamping, plating, assembly)

You start your day by working with stakeholders across the PLM/S4HANA digital transformation program and the Clarification & Logistics organization. You collaborate with subject matter experts, process owners, business leaders, and project teams to align business requirements, optimize service and logistics processes, and support organizational readiness. Throughout the day, you facilitate workshops, contribute to process harmonization and solution design activities, monitor user adoption, and provide leadership updates. Your role combines business transformation, process management, change management, and digitalization to ensure the successful implementation of PLM360 and SAP S/4HANA solutions across a global service organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Central coordination of business transformation and digital transformation activities between the PLM/S4HANA Get Ready Team and the Clarification & Logistics organization, ensuring alignment of business priorities, requirements, and deployment readiness

Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

PMO Manager (m/f/d)

The PMO Manager will play a central role in the transformation of the portfolio company by driving program visibility, consistency, and delivery discipline across the organization. Program Governance & Structure

- Support leadership in prioritizing and sequencing strategic initiatives
- Define and manage the cadence of steering committees and progress reviews

Performance Tracking & Reporting

- Develop and maintain dashboards, status reports, and KPIs to monitor milestones, risks, and interdependencies across workstreams
- Prepare progress updates for management and AURELIUS

Stakeholder Management & Communication

- Act as central liaison between executive leadership, functional heads, external partners and AURELIUS
- Ensure transparent communication of progress, risks, and outcomes across the organization and AURELIUS

Change Management:

- Drive the people side of transformation by anticipating change implications, supporting communication plans, and fostering ownership among stakeholders
- Help the leadership team translate strategic goals into actionable change narratives and embed new ways of working into the organization

Content & Strategic Sparring:

- Act as a thought partner to the CEO, CFO, and project leads in structuring initiatives, challenging assumptions, and shaping project content
- Support preparation of management and AURELIUS board materials by synthesizing complex topics into clear messages and actionable insights

Continuous Improvement:

- Identify opportunities to enhance project effectiveness and institutionalize best practices across the organization

Qualifications required

Experience & Background

jobs.description:
Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
